purpose: Compile-only diagnosis of the fresh multi-action fanout goal.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import importlib.util,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/goal_compiler.py')
s=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('gc',p); m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(s); s.loader.exec_module(m)
reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/runtime/BOUND_CAPABILITY_REGISTRY_V1.json').read_text())['capabilities']
goal=json.loads(pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/missions/ASTRA_RUNTIME_MULTI_ACTION_FANOUT_001.json').read_text())['goal']
try:
    out=m.compile_goal(goal,reg,pathlib.Path('.').resolve())
except m.GoalCompilationFailure as exc:
    print(json.dumps({'status':'BLOCKED','code':exc.code,'detail':exc.detail},sort_keys=True))
    print('MULTI_ACTION_FANOUT_COMPILER_BLOCKED')
else:
    print(json.dumps({'status':'COMPILED','mode':out.get('compiler_mode'),'parts':out.get('compiled_parts'),'actions':out.get('controller_actions')},sort_keys=True))
    print('MULTI_ACTION_FANOUT_COMPILER_COMPILED')
PY
